annotations.title: x402 seller check (organic revenue + scanner/loop share)

description: Before paying or listing an x402 seller: its last 30d / 7d organic x402 revenue, payments and distinct buyers (Agent GDP, CC BY 4.0), plus the 7d share of its revenue paid by known scanner/crawler wallets and a closed-loop (self-pay) signal from Base on-chain USDC flows. Cached 1h. Unavailable upstream = HTTP 503, not charged. No free tier; $0.01/call via x402 (MCP params._meta["x402/payment"] or HTTP) or X-API-Key credits. Failed calls are not charged. [served by tools.moneytools.dev]

address.description: seller payTo address (0x; Solana base58 when chain=solana)

chain.description: base (default) | solana | arbitrum | polygon | arc; scanner/loop signals are Base only
